hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a univariate diagonal specialization g(t) = M(t, t). Evaluate g at t=1 and t=2 to obtain the two M-calls; the raw expression is their sum.
required_assumptions: The diagonal specialization M(t, t) is defined for the integer arguments 1 and 2.
hypotheses.rationale: Both M-calls are diagonal evaluations of the same declared bivariate function M, so they are members of the one-parameter diagonal specialization M(t, t).
